title: Can I BEAT Horde Chess?
summary: Horde chess: White has a mass of pawns and no king; Black has a normal army. White wins by checkmating Black; Black wins by capturing all White pawns. He plays the horde, filling gaps and avoiding letting pieces reach his back rank, winning games by promoting/overrunning.
rules: White: 36 pawns (ranks 1-4 full + f5,g5,b5,c5), no king. Black: standard army.
White pawns on rank 1 may move two squares (standard chess.com horde).
White wins by checkmating Black; Black wins by capturing all White pieces.
current_impl_issues: Current 'Horde' roughly right; ensure player plays White horde and Black has full army, and no-blank-space strategy not needed.

current_impl.explain: You are 36 pawns with no king. Checkmate the bot before your horde is wiped out.
